title: The Umbra Circle
logline: A criminal board of directors, exposed through the museum itself.
blurb: Two investigative founders build the world's first museum of crime convergence. When a diplomat is assassinated in London, they are drawn into a web of espionage and uncover The Umbra Circle: a network of politicians, financiers, and organized-crime groups manipulating world systems for power and profit.

title: The Dragon Roars Forward
logline: The state actor that let them build it steps in to collect.

title: The Condor Directive
logline: An older, colder alliance of intelligence services wakes south of the equator.
